description: This Java class converts a given Map of query parameters into a Map of header key-value pairs based on a predefined set of headers obtained from HttpConfig. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and related to handling HTTP headers and query parameters in service endpoints.

classes.name: QueryParametersToHeadersMap
classes.description: An immutable class implementing UnaryOperator that maps query parameters to header key-value pairs based on configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of QueryParametersToHeadersMap using HttpConfig, which provides the set of headers to map.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Transforms a map of query parameters into a map of headers, including only those that match headers defined in the configuration.
